title: Singleton coefficient of a linear form
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $a$ assign a real number to each of the $n$ coordinates, and let $i$ be one of those coordinates. The Fourier coefficient of the linear form $x\\mapsto\\sum_{r=0}^{n-1}a_r x_r$ at the singleton set $\\{i\\}$ is $a_i$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ assigns a real number to each coordinate in $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$
